newsitem.title: USA: Calif agency collects $100 mln in delinquent revs.
newsitem.headline: Calif agency collects $100 mln in delinquent revs.

text.p: California Department of Motor Vehicles said it has reached a $100 million milestone in collecting delinquent vehicle registration fees.
More than $64 million of the money collected has gone to cities and counties, the department said. The rest went to other state funds, including the general fund.

The accounts of all vehicle owners who do not respond to the department's final request for payment are transferred to the state's Franchise Tax Board. The board sends out more than 5,000 late collection requests a week.
